يستقطبوا (form X)
# يَسْتَقْطِبُوا (yastaqṭibū) /jas.taq.tˤi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
# يُسْتَقْطَبُوا (yustaqṭabū) /jus.taq.tˤa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
